blind.description: A stylized fantasy arcane pylon featuring a tapered square stone pillar base in dark greenish-grey, banded by two bronze metal collars. At the top of the pillar, a four-pronged bronze metallic cradle securely holds a large, vertical, faceted purple gemstone/crystal tapering to a point. All surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A square pedestal profile with four bronze cradle prongs around the edges, centered on the pointed faceted peak of a glowing purple crystal.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 70-75% the height of the figure (around 4 to 4.3 ft tall), with a square base footprint roughly 1.2 ft across.
